limitations: Managed CarPlay capability and device runtime behavior require unavailable external Apple state or an unlocked physical device.
No production App ID or profile exists in the repository. Apple Developer portal submission/approval was not accessed, so this external gate is blocked rather than inferred. It is not waived.

The isolated harness schedules three manifest-backed background URLSession transfers and tests validation, restoration, atomic publication, final-file probing, and duplicate acknowledgement rejection. SpringBoard denied the single bounded launch because the paired device was locked. Suspension, termination, relaunch delivery, cancellation/resume, and exactly-once runtime acknowledgement remain unproven; simulator evidence does not replace this gate.
This proves only local development signing and installation of the isolated harness. It does not prove production signing or execution; the launch remains blocked by the locked device.
